name: Tiny Moose 42
author: ahmed_8975
description: Glass neon gradient lime checkbox that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks:
On hover, border-color becomes #c8f060, transform becomes scale(1.06), text color changes from #ffffff to #ffffff. Clicking it toggles it: background changes from #ffffff to linear-gradient(135deg, #c8f060, #60f0b8), border-color becomes transparent, box-shadow becomes 0 0 0 3px #c8f060,
    0 4px 14px #c8f060.
